5. It serializes `map2` into a byte array and tries to deserialize it back into an object.
6. The test expects an `UnsupportedOperationException` to be thrown during the deserialization process.
7. If the exception is not thrown, the test fails with the message "unsafe clazz accepted when de-serializing MultiValueMap".
